assessments.label: PARTIAL
cv_quotes: Built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 40 PDF reports using LangChain, OpenAI embeddings, and a FAISS vector store.
Served it with FastAPI in a Docker container; wrote an evaluation set of 30 questions to check answer accuracy.
Topics: machine learning, deep learning basics, LLM applications, MLOps with Docker and FastAPI.
